fact: ExperimentJob exports caseReceipts only if current method==scopeAll. On mid-batch exception current method remains failing subcase, so earlier completed case snapshots remain in retained Job memory but are omitted from final/pending receipt. Current failing observation/firstFailure and original ownership are still present.
consequence: Cannot claim complete externally exported per-case evidence on partial failure. Do not schedule device as fully evidence-ready.
proposalNotApplied: Next concentrated source batch export existing caseReceipts whenever requestedMethod==scopeAll, mark partial/completed counts even failure, with same byte-budget checks; no additional worker or replay.

consequence: 8MiB applies native physical attempt accounting; exact SDK requested total remains UNAVAILABLE, not fabricated from actual bytes or readCalls. Layer-separated reporting needs next batch if mandatory.
